Great question! 🌿

**No, the 90-day guarantee only applies to plants ordered while your Leafy Plus membership is active.** Plants you bought before joining keep the standard **30-day guarantee**, counted from their delivery date.

- **Bought before joining:** 30-day guarantee from delivery
- **Ordered while your membership is active:** 90-day guarantee from delivery

If a plant you bought before joining is having trouble and is still within its 30 days, you can start a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (the whole plant plus a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days.

Even if a plant is outside its guarantee window, our Plant Care Specialists are happy to give free care advice by chat (9am-5pm Mon-Fri) or by email at help@leafy.example, so you don't have to figure it out alone.

Is there anything else I can help you with? Happy planting! 🪴
